items.text: This game could be improved with better sound design, storytelling elements, and UI improvements, but of course, this is a pre-release game.  I have had tons of fun exploring abandoned space stations, getting boarded by pirates, trading on the black market, and fitting my ship out.  This game has a lot of potential and I cannot wait for the full release!
items.text_zh: 这款游戏可以通过更好的音效设计、叙事元素和UI改进来提升，但当然，这是一款预发布游戏。我在探索废弃空间站、被海盗登船、在黑市交易以及装配我的飞船中获得了大量乐趣。这款游戏潜力巨大，我迫不及待想看到完整发布！

observations.evidence: This game could be improved with better sound design
observations.evidence_zh: 这款游戏可以通过更好的音效设计来改进
